description: SaaS platform compatibility contract. The platform is the hub: every known consumer module is declared here. Convention: in this ecosystem a module's caret range ^0.x is platform-major bounded (>=0.x.0 <1.0.0), so an additive platform minor never forces a module release - the platform's MAJOR bump is the only event that requires modules to update their ranges. The ContractTest reads each module's composer.json require and asserts the CURRENT platform release satisfies it. Modules run the reverse guard in their own ModuleCoreCompatibilityTest (installed platform must satisfy their declared constraint).
